about: Release public keys (docs/contract/UPDATES.md section 3). A build's anchors are generated from this file: firmware environments take the production keys only, the simulated boards and native tests the test key. The test key is derived from a public label (SHA-256 of the label is its seed) and is valid nowhere. Custody and recovery of the production keys: docs/RELEASE_KEYS.md.
